purpose: Initial FP16 GEMM vertical slice. Results are effective throughput observations, not peak specifications.
timing_scope: Two hundred pre-created MUSA event pairs each surround exactly one preallocated TileLang GEMM call; all samples are enqueued before one final synchronization. Compilation, allocation, reference computation and correctness checking are excluded.
measurement_revision: Supersedes per-sample event batches. Uses preallocated output, 200 warmups, pre-created per-call events, queued submission and one final synchronization to avoid allocator pollution and Python batch submission gaps.
